outcome: Coagulation parameters (Fg, APTT, prothrombin, D-dimer, anti-Xa assay, rotation thromboelastometry, thrombodynamics/thrombodynamics-4D)
finding: This study found that coagulation assays revealed hypercoagulation after delivery and a tendency toward normalization of coagulation during early postpartum, with the thromboprophylaxis group showing a higher percentage of coagulation parameters within the normal range.
